nc.description: A light-colored, interconnected structure features a curved arm passing through a ring situated above a central cylinder with rectangular side blocks.
A 3D rendering displays a light grey mechanical coupling assembly connecting a smooth shaft to a splined shaft.
An untextured, white 3D model of a mechanical structure with articulated legs and circular footpads stands stationary on a flat surface.
A 3D rendering shows a central grey disc positioned behind a white cylinder, flanked by a cluster of grey faceted blocks on the left and a structured assembly of white faceted blocks on the right.
A collection of various grey and white mechanical components is arranged symmetrically around a central handle-like object on a white background.

vc.description: A grey tool with a handle and threaded end is positioned above a white cylinder clamped in a vise.
Four separate panels display 3D renderings of mechanical components, specifically a cylinder, a mounting bracket, a vise clamping a rod, and a threaded shaft.
A grey tool with two suction cups connected by a central spring mechanism is displayed against a white background.
A grey, articulated mechanical arm holds a threaded cylindrical component suspended over a cracked white bowl resting in a base.
An assembled mechanical device sits in the center of a symmetrical arrangement of unassembled parts on sprues, casing pieces, brackets, and piles of small pellets on a white surface.
